Connectivity and convenience are front and center with a navigation system, Bluetooth integration, a premium sound system, and WiFi hotspot capability. The power liftgate and running boards add practicality, making loading and entry seamless. For those who want a commanding presence combined with intelligent design, the Tahoe Z71 stands ready to meet every challenge with style and confidence. description: 2024 FORD F-450 SUPER DUTY LIMITED 4X4  AGATE BLACK METALLIC  ONE-OWNER TEXAS TRUCK  64,504 MILES  $107,100 MSRP  WICKED 4 SUSPENSION  FOX 2.0s  24 AMERICAN FORCE  38 TOYO R/T TRAILS  FULL COLOR-MATCHED BUILD  There are lifted F-450s, and then there are trucks that have been built correctly from the start. This 2024 Ford F-450 Super Duty Limited 4x4 Crew Cab is exactly that kind of truck.  Finished in Agate Black Metallic over Fords ultra-premium Admiral Blue / Light Slate Limited interior, this is a one-owner Texas truck with only 64,504 miles, excellent ownership history, dealer service and maintenance, and an original factory MSRP of approximately $107,100 before any of the aftermarket upgrades were added.  Then roughly $25,000 was invested into the build.  The result is one of the cleanest, most complete, best-proportioned F-450 builds you can put together: a Wicked 4-inch suspension system, FOX 2.0 Performance Series shocks, Wicked radius-arm armor, 24-inch American Force forged wheels, 38-inch Toyo Open Country R/T Trail tires, extensive factory-color-matched exterior treatment, and a completely blacked-out/murdered-out appearance that looks aggressive without crossing over into something gaudy.  And on top of all of that, this truck is a LimitedFords flagship Super Duty trimand 2024 was the final model year for the F-450 Limited, making this an especially desirable configuration.  THE FACTORY TRUCK  $107,100 ORIGINAL MSRP  This truck was heavily equipped from Ford before anyone ever touched the suspension.  At the heart of it is Fords 6.7-liter High-Output Power Stroke V8 Turbo Diesel, paired with the 10-speed TorqShift automatic transmission and Fords heavy-duty 4x4 drivetrain.  This is the engine you want in a late-model Super Duty. The High-Output Power Stroke was designed to deliver massive torque and effortless pulling power, whether the truck is towing, hauling, traveling or simply being driven every day.  Underneath it, the F-450 chassis gives you the serious hardware that separates this truck from a standard three-quarter-ton or one-ton pickup: wide-track front axle geometry, heavy-duty axles, dual rear wheels, massive braking capability, serious payload and towing architecture, and the turning radius these F-450s are famous for.  The Limited package then takes that commercial-grade capability and wraps it in one of the most luxurious interiors Ford has ever installed in a pickup truck.  AGATE BLACK METALLIC  FULLY COLOR MATCHED  The exterior color is Agate Black Metallic, and instead of leaving the truck with the standard assortment of contrasting plastics and trim, this one received an extensive custom color-match treatment.  The goal was simple: make the entire truck look cohesive.  The grille, fog-light surrounds, exterior plastic trim, vents and multiple accent pieces have all been refinished to match the factory Agate Black Metallic paint, giving the truck a much cleaner and much more expensive appearance than the typical bolt-on build.  This is not just a black truck with black wheels.  The entire exterior has been carefully tied together so that everything flows in one color palette.  The finished result is what most people are trying to achieve when they say murdered outblack body, black trim, black suspension components and black/milled wheels, with just enough machined detail in the American Forces to keep it from looking flat.  It has an extremely sinister appearance in person.  WICKED 4-INCH SUSPENSION SYSTEM  The truck sits on a Wicked 4-inch suspension lift kit, which is one of the biggest reasons the proportions of the truck look so good.  Four inches is an ideal height on an F-450 because it gives the truck a noticeably more aggressive stance while still retaining the geometry and usability expected from a truck of this caliber.  The system is paired with FOX 2.0 Performance Series shocks, giving the suspension package both the look and the hardware expected on a premium build.  The truck also has Wicked radius-arm armor plating, finished in gloss black. That detail matters because the radius arms and lower suspension components are highly visible on a lifted F-450. Instead of leaving those components looking unfinished, the gloss-black armor gives the suspension a much more custom, complete appearance.  The lift package, shocks and armor all work together visually with the rest of the truck rather than looking like separate aftermarket parts bolted onto a factory pickup.  24-INCH AMERICAN FORCE FORGED WHEELS  Nothing finishes an F-450 build like the right forged wheel, and this truck is sitting on a set of 24-inch American Force forged aluminum wheels.  They are finished in a gloss-black and milled combination, which is exactly the right finish against the Agate Black Metallic body.  American Force is one of the premier names in forged truck wheels, and they look right at home on a truck at this level.  The milled accents break up the black finish just enough to show the wheel design, while the gloss-black face keeps the entire truck looking dark and aggressive.  38X13.50R24 TOYO OPEN COUNTRY R/T TRAIL TIRES  Wrapped around those American Forces are a set of 38x13.50R24 Toyo Open Country R/T Trail tires.  These tires are in like-new condition and completely change the presence of the truck.  The 38-inch diameter fills the wheel wells perfectly with the 4-inch Wicked suspension and gives the F-450 the tall, planted stance that makes these trucks look so impressive.  The R/T Trail is also a great tire choice for a truck like this because it delivers the aggressive appearance of a rugged-terrain tire without going all the way into an extreme mud-terrain setup.  The wheel, tire and suspension combination is extremely well proportioned.  Nothing looks too small. Nothing looks excessively stretched. The truck simply sits right.  EXTENDED OFF-ROAD MUD FLAPS  The truck is also equipped with aftermarket extended off-road mud flaps, which provide additional protection behind the oversized tire package.  That extra coverage matters with a 38-inch tire and helps keep road debris from constantly being thrown down the sides of the truck.  It is another small detail that shows the build was put together with actual usability in mind.  LIMITED INTERIOR  ADMIRAL BLUE / LIGHT SLATE  Inside is where the Limited separates itself from nearly every other Super Duty.  This truck has Fords distinctive Admiral Blue / Light Slate Limited leather interior, one of the most recognizable and upscale interiors available in the Super Duty lineup.  The cabin is loaded with premium materials, soft-touch surfaces, upgraded trim and the kind of equipment normally associated with a luxury SUVnot a truck capable of serious commercial-grade towing.  Factory Limited equipment includes premium multi-contour leather seating, power-adjustable front seats, driver memory, heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, premium leather-wrapped interior surfaces, power-adjustable pedals, power tilt-and-telescoping steering column, dual-zone automatic climate control, intelligent access, push-button start, remote start, power windows, power locks, premium trim and extensive cabin storage.  The front seats are incredibly comfortable for long-distance driving, and the Crew Cab provides a tremendous amount of rear-seat room for passengers.  B&O UNLEASHED SOUND SYSTEM  The truck is equipped with the B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen, featuring Fords premium multi-speaker audio arrangement with subwoofer.  This is not the standard Super Duty stereo.  The B&O Unleashed system was designed as a true premium audio setup and provides far better clarity, depth and cabin coverage than the basic factory system.  Combined with the large Ford infotainment screen and modern connectivity, the interior feels every bit as modern as you would expect from a six-figure flagship truck.  FORD SYNC / LARGE CENTER TOUCHSCREEN  The Limited also includes Fords large center infotainment system with SYNC connectivity, smartphone integration, Bluetooth capability, FordPass connectivity and access to vehicle, navigation and towing functions through the central display.  The large screen also works hand-in-hand with the trucks camera system, which is extremely helpful on an F-450 of this size.  360-DEGREE CAMERA SYSTEM  One of the most useful factory features on this truck is the 360-degree camera system.  Between the trucks overall size, dually rear end, 38-inch tires and custom stance, being able to see around the vehicle from the center display makes parking and maneuvering dramatically easier.  The system provides multiple views around the truck and works in conjunction with the front and rear parking sensors.  BLIND SPOT INFORMATION SYSTEM  The truck is equipped with Fords Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert.  On an F-450 Crew Cab dually, this is much more than a convenience feature.  The system helps monitor areas beside and behind the truck that can be difficult to see, particularly in traffic and when backing out of parking spaces.  Ford also integrates trailer-related functionality into its towing-assistance systems, making the technology particularly valuable for owners who actually use the truck to tow.  ADAPTIVE CRUISE CONTROL  The Limited includes Adaptive Cruise Control, which is a major comfort feature during highway driving.  The system can automatically adjust the trucks speed to help maintain following distance from traffic ahead, making long road trips significantly more comfortable.  PRE-COLLISION ASSIST / AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING  Fords factory safety technology also includes Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, designed to monitor traffic ahead and assist the driver if a potential collision is detected.  Combined with lane-related assistance, parking sensors, cameras, blind-spot monitoring and the trucks heavy-duty braking system, it gives the F-450 an impressive suite of active safety equipment.  LED LIGHTING PACKAGE  The truck is equipped with premium LED exterior lighting, including LED headlamps, LED taillamps and additional exterior lighting technology. SERIOUS FACTORY TOWING TECHNOLOGY  This truck was designed from the factory to tow. The F-450 gives you the wider front track, commercial-grade hardware, larger brakes and serious towing-oriented chassis engineering that make these trucks so desirable.  Even with the custom lift and 38-inch tire setup, the underlying truck is still designed to perform the heavy-duty work expected from the F-450 nameplate. Dual front zone air conditioning lets front passengers set their preferred temperatures independently, while the automatic temperature control maintains your chosen settings. The power driver seat adjusts multiple ways for personalized positioning, and heated door mirrors add year-round practicality. An auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare, and the telescoping, tilt steering wheel ensures proper positioning for drivers of different heights.  Safety has been prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control help maintain grip and stability, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist provide reliable stopping power. Rear parking sensors make maneuvering in tight spaces straightforward, and the low tire pressure warning system helps you maintain proper inflation.  Entertainment and connectivity options include the SiriusXM satellite radio with CD and MP3 capability, six speakers distributed throughout the cabin, and steering wheel mounted audio controls that keep your hands on the wheel. The trip computer provides useful driving data, while the outside temperature display and compass offer practical information at a glance.
